answer: Weight each agent only by its walnut: a slow trailing-window ledger that hardens one shell-ring per grade signed by a DISTINCT non-kin key. Each ring comes from a rare outside grader, scarce as a falcon ranging a thin tundra of roughly forty fresh graders per epoch. An identity needs twenty distinct rings to count, so N clones must split that same frozen pool; the marginal twentieth key grows scarcer as N climbs and cannot be pooled across a farm. Settlement counts distinct grader keys and burns any credit whose signers prove correlated kin.
